title: Clarified Unmanaged Account Resolution Logic
summary: The Directory API documentation now explicitly details the HTTP response codes returned when resolving unmanaged user account conflicts during user creation.
details: The 'users.insert' method description has been updated to clarify the behavior of the 'resolveConflictAccount' parameter. It now specifies that a 200 response indicates successful creation or replacement, 202 indicates an invitation was sent to an unmanaged personal account, and 409 indicates a conflict that prevents creation (such as an existing unmanaged work account or a policy to preserve the account). New documentation links for resolving duplicate account errors and transferring unmanaged work accounts have also been added to assist with troubleshooting provisioning failures.
